sequence_points.name: Abstract Geometric Textile Wall Hanging
sequence_points.description: A vertically oriented textile artwork featuring a central dark vertical band flanked by lighter, patterned sections with repeating geometric motifs. The piece is mounted on a wall and displays a monochromatic color scheme with subtle texture variations.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Geometric Composition
sequence_points.description: A monochromatic abstract painting featuring angular, geometric shapes in shades of gray and white, arranged in a fragmented composition that suggests a stylized figure or architectural form. The artwork is mounted on a wall with a visible frame.
